subject.title: fix(voice-call): avoid OpenAI realtime double greeting

question: Should this OpenAI realtime voice-call fix wait for redacted live Twilio/OpenAI outbound-call proof on the current head, or may maintainers accept the focused source-harness proof for this timing-sensitive provider path?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the patch shape is narrow, but repository policy and prior review comments require real affected-surface proof for external provider/channel timing when feasible.

options.title: Require live outbound-call proof
options.body: Have a contributor or maintainer run a redacted Twilio/OpenAI outbound call on the current head showing one initial greeting and normal post-greeting caller audio before merge.

options.title: Accept source-harness proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the focused mocked regression coverage while owning any live OpenAI/Twilio timing regression discovered after release.

options.title: Pause until proof owner is available
options.body: Keep the PR open under maintainer handling until someone with the right OpenAI and telephony setup can run the affected path.

recommendation.title: Require live outbound-call proof
recommendation.body: Have a contributor or maintainer run a redacted Twilio/OpenAI outbound call on the current head showing one initial greeting and normal post-greeting caller audio before merge.
